snippet.title: CRIMSON | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
CRIMSON is a violent, gothic, roguelite, action-horror game all about a church arising out of Hell, and a heartbroken woman named Evelyn Chandler venturing inside to kill Count Dracula and his family. This is a blood-filled war out of love, revenge, and hunger.

Created by @jasmine_vex 

Find the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4093160/CRIMSON/
